1264.name: IGT Routine Clinic| Ages 6+ | Friday, March 20 2026 | 6:15pm-7:15pm | $35
1264.description: This clinic is exclusively for athletes currently enrolled in our IGT Program.  Join us for focused routine work on all apparatus — vault, bars, beam, and floor. Gymnasts will have the opportunity to refine routine structure, improve skill execution, strengthen connections, and enhance performance quality and confidence.  Coaches will provide event-specific corrections, drills, and feedback to help athletes clean up details and prepare for evaluations or upcoming competitions.  This is a great opportunity for extra reps and individualized attention in a positive, structured training environment. Space is limited — be sure to register early!  Click HERE to signup!!

1278.name: Bridge Kickover Clinic | Ages 6+ | Sunday, March 29, 2026 | 2:30pm-4:00pm | $40

Clinics are led by experienced coaches and are ideal for gymnasts looking to refine existing skills, learn new ones, or get extra practice outside of regular classes. Open to various ages and skill levels, with groups organized appropriately to ensure safety and individualized attention.
